verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI agents are plain Python objects callable via run()/run_sync() in scripts, with a CLI (clai), durable execution support, and OpenTelemetry/Logfire tracing—all of which support headless/CI usage, and TestModel/FunctionModel enable CI-friendly testing without live API calls. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), no first-party docs on non-interactive/headless flags or exit-code conventions for automation, and no independent community confirmation of CI usage specifically.
